classification.difficultyReason: Apply the taught positive and negative cases, undo one translation in each case, and represent the two discrete solutions as closed points on a number line. The eight parts repeat this direct procedure without additional strategic decisions.

content.prompt: Solve each equation and graph the solution on a number line.
